title: Research Lifecycle V1.0
scope: Strategy-independent trading research from hypothesis through research decision

stages.title: Research Idea / Hypothesis
stages.purpose: Declare the proposed market mechanism and falsifiable research question before implementation.

stages.title: Data Qualification
stages.purpose: Establish that the dataset, timestamps, mappings, sessions, adjustments, and partitions are fit for purpose.

stages.title: Feature Validation
stages.purpose: Prove that derived market information is mathematically correct, causal, and available at the claimed timestamp.

stages.title: Signal Validation
stages.purpose: Verify that each implemented signal corresponds exactly to the intended market event before performance research.

stages.title: Execution Model Validation
stages.purpose: Validate deterministic and auditable entry, risk, exit, ambiguity, chronology, and session behavior separately from signal generation.

stages.title: Development Baseline
stages.purpose: Describe the simplest meaningful baseline on DEVELOPMENT and decide whether further research is warranted.

stages.title: Development Exploration
stages.purpose: Map parameter response surfaces, interactions, boundaries, trade-offs, sample size, and observability without selecting an isolated maximum.

stages.title: Robustness / Sensitivity
stages.purpose: Distinguish observed performance from robust evidence through perturbation, chronology, temporal, and state sensitivity checks.

stages.title: Candidate Reduction & Freeze
stages.purpose: Select a small candidate set using predeclared criteria and freeze code, configuration, data boundary, and Validation protocol.

stages.title: Confirmatory Validation
stages.purpose: Evaluate only frozen candidates on VALIDATION against predeclared criteria without tuning.

stages.title: Post-Validation Diagnosis
stages.purpose: Retrospectively explain Validation behavior without changing the frozen result or creating confirmatory evidence.

stages.title: Research Decision
stages.purpose: Record REJECTED, REVISE / NEW VERSION, or APPROVED FOR NEXT PHASE without treating approval as live-deployment authority.

future_strategy_lifecycle.purpose: A later lifecycle begins only after research approval; approval is not a terminal strategy state or deployment authorization.
